title: 正文 第十一章 永不消停的石心月
lines: “绝壁隘口怎么会爆发这么强的战斗。”他身材孔武有力，脸颊线条分明，使人感觉到一种刚毅的美。走动起来，龙行虎步，气若泰山，如虬龙般的肌肉充满着爆炸性的力量。
“武坤师哥，苍岚师弟和乐萱师妹还没有来到此地集合，我很担心他们。绝壁隘口是来万物塔的必经之路，不如我们去看看，万一出了事，也好有个补救措施。”说话者名为林雅，她身材高挑，举止端庄。一颦一笑间流露出一种说不出的风韵，美而不艳，一度引起众多人的推崇，其中就包括徐辉。
“此事交由我处理就行，你暂且留在这里，万一战斗起来，我一个人行事也比较方便些。”武坤说完便离开了他们暂时建立的落脚点。
“小心。”看着离去的师兄，林雅担忧，在这里完全要靠自己。不同于外界，有师门做坚强的后盾。
武坤离开万物塔，一路风驰电掣，赶向绝壁隘口。路途中遇见一位与他抱有相同目的的人，他是天剑宗的剑辰。
感应到如此庞大的战斗波动还敢出来的人，皆非凡俗，他们都是同境界的奇才，全力以赴下都可以发出超越当前境界的力量。
他们相互对望了一眼，并未说话，眼神里都透着忌惮，不到万不得已，他们都不希望与彼此战斗。
两人大步流星，一前一后进入绝壁隘口，听到隘口深处传来的战斗声。二人徒然加势，速度再提三分。
绝壁隘口笔直，而修者目力又远超常人。一进隘口，二人都看见远方的战斗，也看见了他们要找的人。
“一人一个。”看着岌岌可危的几人，二人暂时达成了同盟。
“人剑合一。”剑辰大呵，整个人瞬间变得犀利。化为一抹寒光，超越了肉身极限，迸发而去，直接消失了身影。
“师妹，对不起，我不该带你来。”陆典悲伤，他已经没有了丝毫的力气，唯一能做的就是将王语兰紧紧的抱在怀里。只要他还活着，就不能让王语兰先死。
看着已经抽到他面前的触手，陆典闭上了眼睛。不过想象的疼痛一直没有传来，陆典睁开眼睛一看，一道人形寒光来回穿梭于幽海天章周围。须臾间，庞大的幽海天章便轰然倒地，滩烂泥般的肉体上布满了人腰粗细的洞口。与此同时，他面前出现了一个人，将他和王语兰护在了身后。
“大师兄。”陆典惊讶，眼神里泛发出一丝光彩。他的这位师兄年龄小于他，他从来没有认真叫过他，因为他不服。
看着守护他和王语兰的笔直的身影，陆典放下了曾经高傲的头颅。这一刻，他才从心底里认可他的这个大师兄。“原来这就是差距。”
“这是幽海天章的兽丹，先为自己疗伤，至于什么情况，以后再说。”剑辰拿出一枚鸡蛋大小的兽丹，递给了陆典。这是他刚击杀幽海天章是取出来的。
与此同时，武坤如同一头人形暴龙，他比剑辰暴力的多。直接拎起霸王蟹的一只腿，就是一顿猛摔。片刻间石壁便被他毁坏的一塌糊涂。霸王蟹也被抽成了一堆烂泥。看着苍岚的样子，他的心都些颤抖。可以说，苍岚是他带大的，在他眼里，苍岚就是他的亲弟弟。
“不要说话，固守心神。”武坤直接来到苍岚背后，将自己最为精纯的生命精气渡给了苍岚。直到苍岚的伤势停止恶化。
“师哥……上面还有一人，如若不是他，我们早死了！”苍受伤太重，晓是有武坤给他输送生命精气，仍是很虚弱，有些摇摇欲坠。
“放心，这里交给我，苍岚口中的人，不仅救了你的人，也救我的人。这是恩，务必将他救下来。”剑辰性子有些孤傲，不愿意欠他人的情。
武坤点头，脚踏虚空而行。片刻后回到了几人面前，手里拿着半截龟裂的鳞翼，轻轻一捏鳞翼化为了粉末，看着飘散的粉末，武坤摇了摇头。
“对不起，幻兄。”如若不是为我，你怎么会死去，甚至连尸骨都未曾留下，苍岚大悲，气急攻心，晕了过去。
“这……这怎么可能。”徐辉几人不愿意相信，虽说和幻天认识不长，但相处下来甚是投机，如今得知他死去，几人情绪非常低落。
“武坤兄，这次来的遗落之地，处处透着诡异，和往年记载大不相同。我想这其中必有阴谋。”剑辰看着周围狼藉的地面说道。
“反常必有妖，若是到了关键时刻，我们结为同盟如何。”武坤敏锐的感觉到，这还只是开始，接下来将是更大的难关。
“好。”剑辰同意。
“此地不宜久留，休息十分钟后，马上回万物塔的临时基地。”武坤建议。
听武坤说完，受伤的几人拿出疗伤药液，为自己修复伤势。修复完伤势后，武坤和剑辰带领着几人回到了万物塔附近的临时基地。等回到基地，几人才发现，不知何时，少了一个人。
“死流氓，占了姑奶奶的便宜就想跑。我才不相信你死了。”石心月从一道石缝中走出来，小巧玲珑的身体上沾满了灰尘。
content_zh:
人，得天独厚，肉身玄秘莫测，如同微型宇宙，潜藏着数之不尽的宝藏。光明、黑暗、力量、速度、感识、风水雷电、木火雪冰……都在等待着人们的开发。

    万丈高楼平地起，开发的第一个肉身秘藏，事关重大，将会影响接下来一系列的修行方向。能靠自己领舞者凤毛麟角，而不能靠自己领悟者唯有依靠前人经验开发肉身秘藏，虽说也会超越凡俗，但终究是别人的路。最远，也不过是和前人达到同样的高度。

    根据每人选着的方向，修者大致分为三类：武者，术士和念师。其中术士占了修者的九成，他们可沟通天地灵力施展强大的法术，呼风唤雨、锻器炼丹……无所不能。

    剩下的一成武者占了九分，但武者修行之路太过痛苦。并且初始较弱，百分之九十九的人都被困在力轮境，唯有一些大毅力者才能突破肉身的桎梏，引领前沿。一旦武者可以踏空而行，将是术士的噩梦。

    至于最后的念师则神秘莫测，可遇而不可求，只听其名，未见其人。

    看着格斗场中渐渐落入下风的石心月，幻天凝神关注。“也该让你吃点亏了，这可不是外界，可以让你肆意妄为。就算你师傅绝灭道人名声再大，也是有范围的，不可能每个人都让着你。”

    “这个小美女不简单啊！竟然能和巧无心缠斗这么久，巧无心可是开发肉身秘藏的人。”有人说道。

    “是啊！也不知道巧无心走了什么狗屎运，竟然在万物塔的最外围获得了一场造化，得到了前人传承，悟出了属于他的后天秘藏。”

    “真羡慕他，既然悟得了属于自己的后天秘藏。也不知道他的肉身秘藏是什么？”有人好奇。

    “后天秘藏又不是没见过，我真正好奇的是先天秘藏。”

    “是啊，先天秘藏，传说中的存在，连我师父都没有见过。”

    “我曾经听过一个小道消息，说是千年前发生了一场大的变故，具体是什么我也不知道？好像自从那以后，修行境界最后的极限之力都被阻断了。”有人神神秘秘的说道。

    “是啊！否则我们也不用冒险到这遗落之地，也唯有在这种地方，我们才有那么一丝的可能开启肉身秘藏。”

    “也不是如此，我听说在外界也有人可以开启肉身秘藏。只不过太过艰难，而且每个时代的数量也被限制，绝不可能超过五指之数。”

    “我要是可以进入这五人之中就好了。”有人憧憬。

    “你别做梦了，想要在外界开启肉身秘藏，气运、天赋、毅力、底蕴缺一不可。而且会有不祥降临，这才是最可怕的。”说话人有些忌讳，生怕不祥会降临在自己身上。

    “据你所说，在外界一旦开启，岂不皆是先天秘藏。”听到这里幻天好奇，故而询问旁边的一位胖子。

    “哪里来的菜鸟，这都不懂，那可比先天秘藏还要强。传说他们越级杀人如屠狗。”看着幻天一脸好奇宝宝的样子，胖子鼻孔朝天，仿佛他就是那个开启先天秘藏的人。

    “那这样的人多不多。”幻天直接忽略他那一副狗眼看人低的嘴脸继续询问。

    “说你菜鸟你还真菜上了，这种人比之凤毛麟角还有珍贵，怎么可能会多。据可靠消息，能确定的只有一位。至于是谁还不好说，不过我猜测，百分之八十是徐家的人，因为他们千年前曾在遗落之地抓到一个人类。听好了，是遗落之地的人类，不是外界的。”胖子继续说道。

    “对啊对啊，我也听说过，自从那以后徐家可谓是扶摇直上，混的风生水起。东胜洲前三把交椅，徐家算是坐稳了一个。最近更是传出，徐家已经找到了可以在外界开启肉身秘藏的方法了。”有人抢着说道。

    “更有人传闻，徐家将会大批量的培养可以开启先天秘藏的人才。”

    “不对，不对，已经培养出来了。曾经有人看见过。”

    众人越说越神乎，幻天渐渐失去了兴趣。来到了格斗场前沿，看着吃瘪的石心月微笑。

    石新月身法虽然飘渺诡异，但对上已经开启肉身秘藏的巧无心来说还有些不足。据幻天观察，这个巧无心人品还算不错，并未出全力，处处让着石心月，否则她早就败了。还有一点也引起了幻天的注意，是他背负的木盒，里面流动着精纯的木之精华。

    “停，我不打了！你既然能找帮手，那我也要找。”石心月大叫一声，指着微笑的幻天。“看见那白毛了吗？那是我的手下，有本事和他打，若赢了本姑奶奶任你处置。”

    对于石心月，还真是让巧无心头疼，不打吧！自己的师弟受了伤，虽说错在己方，但也罪不至此。打吧！赢了这么一个小姑娘，真是不好说也不好听。如今听见石心月这么一喊，倒也是个折中的好办法。

    “师哥，帮我废了她，我要她和我一样。”旁边一位长着桃花眼的白净少年大喊，眼神燃烧着愤怒的火焰。

    “和这位白发兄弟比试也可，但我若赢了，我要你医好我的师弟。如若可以，我便答应和他决斗。”巧无心并没有理会他的师弟，而是对着石心月说道。
content_en:
Human beings are blessed by nature, and their bodies are mysterious and unpredictable. They are like miniature universes, hiding countless treasures.Light, darkness, strength, speed, perception, feng shui, thunder and lightning, wood, fire, snow and ice... are all waiting for people to develop.

The development of the first physical body secret treasure that rises from the ground is of great importance and will affect the direction of the next series of cultivation.There are very few people who can lead dancers on their own, but those who cannot understand on their own can only rely on the experience of their predecessors to develop the secrets of the body. Although it may transcend the ordinary, it is ultimately the path of others.At the farthest, it can only reach the same height as its predecessors.

According to the direction each person chooses, cultivators are roughly divided into three categories: warriors, sorcerers and mind masters.Among them, warlocks account for 90% of the cultivators. They can communicate with the spiritual power of heaven and earth to cast powerful spells, call wind and rain, forge weapons and refine elixirs... they are omnipotent.

The remaining 10% warriors accounted for nine points, but the journey of warrior cultivation was too painful.And it is weak at the beginning, and 99% of people are trapped in the force wheel realm. Only some people with great perseverance can break through the shackles of the physical body and lead the frontier.Once a warrior can walk through the air, it will be a nightmare for the warlock.

As for the last mind master, he is mysterious and unpredictable. He can be encountered but cannot be sought. I only hear his name but never see his person.

Looking at Shi Xinyue who was gradually losing ground in the fighting arena, Huantian paid close attention."It's time to let you suffer some losses. This is not the outside world, which can let you do whatever you want. No matter how famous your master is as a Taoist exterminator, there is still a limit. It is impossible for everyone to let you."

"This little beauty is not simple! She can actually fight with Qiao Wuxin for so long. Qiao Wuxin is the one who developed the secret of the body." Someone said.

"Yes! I don't know what kind of bad luck Qiao Wuxin had, but he actually received a fortune at the outermost edge of the Tower of All Things, received the inheritance from his predecessors, and realized his acquired secrets."

"I really envy him, now that he has realized his acquired secret. I don't know what his physical secret is?" Someone was curious.

"It's not like I've never seen the acquired secrets before. What I'm really curious about is the innate secrets."

"Yes, the innate secret is a legendary existence that even my master has never seen."

"I once heard a rumor that a big change happened a thousand years ago. I don't know what it was exactly? It seems that since then, the last limit of the cultivation realm has been blocked." Someone said mysteriously.

"Yes! Otherwise we wouldn't have to risk going to this forgotten place. Only in this kind of place can we have the slightest chance of opening the physical secret."

"That's not the case. I heard that there are people in the outside world who can open the physical secret. It's just too difficult, and the number in each era is also limited. It can never exceed the number of five fingers."

"It would be great if I could be among these five people." Some people dreamed.

"Stop dreaming. If you want to open the secret of the physical body in the outside world, luck, talent, perseverance, and heritage are all indispensable. And there will be bad luck coming, which is the most terrifying thing." The speaker is a little taboo, fearing that bad luck will befall him.

"According to what you said, once opened in the outside world, they are all innate secrets." Hearing this, Huantian was curious, so he asked a fat man next to him.

"Where do you come from? Novices don't understand this. It's even better than the innate secret. Legend has it that they leapfrogged the ranks and killed people like butchering dogs." Looking at Huantian's curious expression on the baby, the fat man turned his nostrils upward, as if he was the one who opened the innate secret.

"Are there many people like this?" Huantian ignored his look of contempt and continued to ask.

"You say you are a rookie, but you are really good. Such people are more precious than rare ones. How can there be more of them? According to reliable information, there is only one person who can be confirmed. As for who it is, it is hard to say, but I guess that 80% are people from the Xu family, because they captured a human in the Forgotten Land thousands of years ago. Listen up, it is a human from the Forgotten Land, not from the outside world." Fatty continued.

"Yes, yes, I have also heard that since then, the Xu family has been on the rise and prospered. The Xu family has secured one of the top three positions in Dongshengzhou. Recently, it has been reported that the Xu family has found a way to open the body's secret treasure in the outside world." Someone rushed to say.

"There are even rumors that the Xu family will cultivate a large number of talents who can unlock the innate secrets."

"No, no, it has been cultivated. Someone has seen it before."

The more people talked, the more mysterious it became, and Huantian gradually lost interest.Arriving at the edge of the fighting arena, she looked at the deflated Shi Xinyue and smiled.

Although Shi Xinyue's movement technique is ethereal and strange, it is still not enough for Qiao Wuxin, who has already opened the secret of the physical body.According to Huantian's observation, Qiao Wuxin's character was quite good, and she did not exert all her strength, giving way to Shi Xinyue at every turn, otherwise she would have been defeated long ago.Another thing that caught Huantian's attention was the wooden box he was carrying, which contained the pure essence of wood.

"Stop, I won't fight! Since you can find help, I will find one too." Shi Xinyue shouted, pointing at the smiling Huantian."Did you see that white hair? Those are my men. If you have the ability to fight him, if you win, I will let you do whatever you want."

Shi Xinyue is really a headache for Qiao Wuxin, so don't fight her!His junior brother was injured. Although it was his own fault, it was not his fault.Fight!It's really hard to say and hear that you won over such a little girl.Now that I heard Shi Xinyue shouting like this, it was a good compromise.

"Brother, help me destroy her, I want her to be like me." A fair-skinned young man with peach blossom eyes shouted next to him, his eyes burning with angry flames.

"You can compete with this white-haired brother, but if I win, I want you to heal my junior brother. If possible, I will agree to duel with him." Qiao Wuxin ignored his junior brother and said to Shi Xinyue.
